instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium full shot shows an outdoor concrete courtyard in front of a white building during the day. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt and cap (R1) is kneeling on the ground, looking up with a joyful laugh. He holds the toddler in the brown overalls (R2) upright in the air. The toddler (R2), positioned on the right, wears a black beanie and colorful sneakers, looking down with a smile while suspended. The man's hands support the toddler under his arms, while the toddler's hands rest on the man's forearms. The scene is illuminated by bright, diffused daylight with natural colors and soft shadows.
